trans-unit.source: Your cooking tastes like it came out of a horse's ass.
trans-unit.target: Your cooking tastes like it came out of a horse's ass.

trans-unit.source: Hah, mine? It's like fine wine compared to *someone else's*.
trans-unit.target: Hah, mine? It's like fine wine compared to *someone else's*.

trans-unit.source: Oh, shut up already! Everyone has their strong and weak points, so who cares anyway?
trans-unit.target: Oh, shut up already! Everyone has their strong and weak points, so who cares anyway?

trans-unit.source: But you'll never land a husband if you can't cook, will you?
trans-unit.target: But you'll never land a husband if you can't cook, will you?

trans-unit.source: Hmph! You know what? I'll just get one who can do it for me!
trans-unit.target: Hmph! You know what? I'll just get one who can do it for me!
